nodes.evidence: processSecureChannelMessage /src/open62541/src/server/ua_server_binary.c:628 appears as frame #4 of the ASan 'previously allocated by' stack in the vul reproduction, so the reassembled OPC UA message cleared SecureChannel framing and was admitted into MSG dispatch on the executed path.

processMSG is witnessed on the executed path: frame #3 of the ASan allocation stack is processMSG /src/open62541/src/server/ua_server_binary.c:458 (the CreateSession dispatch in the same function). The decode at line 441 is the immediately-preceding statement in processMSG; exact-line coverage of 441 is Tier-B (needs a coverage rebuild) and is recorded deferred in reachability_report.json.

ASan 'previously allocated by thread T0' frame #1 = UA_SessionManager_createSession /src/open62541/src/server/ua_session_manager.c:142; the 368-byte region [0x613000037240,0x6130000373b0) is the session_list_entry. Source at vul image confirms line 142 is `session_list_entry *newentry = (session_list_entry *)UA_malloc(sizeof(session_list_entry));`.

The untrusted CreateSessionRequest materializes into the 368-byte session_list_entry (cleanupCallback embedded at offset 0). This is the allocation whose address (0x613000037240) is the exact ASan crash address, so the materialized object IS the dangling object.

Same PoC (md5 2925594e560c6948ed4de19eb1e83f1c): vul image (n132/arvo:10676-vul) crashes HUAF READ 8 at ua_workqueue.c:251; fix image (n132/arvo:10676-fix, commit 21771329) runs clean ('Execution successful', exit 0). The patch's only behavioral change is moving synchronous subscription/publish-queue teardown into removeSession before UA_WorkQueue_enqueueDelayed. Vul-crash && fix-clean => the missing pre-enqueue subscription teardown at removeSession is the root cause. removeSession:56 is also necessarily on the executed path: the region freed at ua_workqueue.c:255 (dc==&sentry->cleanupCallback, offset 0) is enqueued into delayedCallbacks ONLY by removeSession:56 (confirmed verbatim in vul source: `UA_WorkQueue_enqueueDelayed(&sm->server->workQueue, &sentry->cleanupCallback);`).

ASan 'freed by thread T0' frame #1 = UA_WorkQueue_manuallyProcessDelayed /src/open62541/src/ua_workqueue.c:255 (reached via UA_Server_run_shutdown:553 -> UA_WorkQueue_cleanup:61). Vul source line 255 is `UA_free(dc);`. This is the first cleanup pass that frees the session entry.

ASan crash frame #0 = UA_WorkQueue_manuallyProcessDelayed /src/open62541/src/ua_workqueue.c:251 (reached via UA_Server_delete:218 -> UA_WorkQueue_cleanup:61), heap-use-after-free READ of size 8 at 0x613000037240. Vul source line 251 is `SIMPLEQ_FOREACH_SAFE(dc, &wq->delayedCallbacks, next, dc_tmp) {` — the second cleanup pass reads dc->next from the freed node.

edges.evidence: Contiguous frames in the ASan allocation stack: processSecureChannelMessage:628 (#4) directly calls processMSG:458 (#3).

Contiguous ASan allocation-stack frames processMSG:458 (#3) -> Service_CreateSession:107 (#2) -> UA_SessionManager_createSession:142 (#1) witness that the decoded request drives the session_list_entry allocation.

edges.evidence: The freed object at ua_workqueue.c:255 is &sentry->cleanupCallback, enqueued only at removeSession:56. Fixing removeSession (fix image) removes the crash, confirming the causal control edge from the root-cause enqueue to the delayed free/UAF.

edges.evidence: ASan reports the crash address is '0 bytes inside of 368-byte region [0x613000037240,0x6130000373b0)', 'freed by' ua_workqueue.c:255 and 'previously allocated by' createSession:142 — same region, alloc precedes free.

edges.via: free_before_use: freed at ua_workqueue.c:255 (run_shutdown pass) then read at ua_workqueue.c:251 (UA_Server_delete pass)
edges.evidence: ASan heap-use-after-free: the READ 8 at ua_workqueue.c:251 (UA_Server_delete:218 cleanup pass) targets the region freed at ua_workqueue.c:255 (UA_Server_run_shutdown:553 cleanup pass). Free strictly precedes the post-free use on the same address (shadow byte 'fd' freed).

root_cause_criterion.evidence: UAF lifetime: the session_list_entry (dc == &sentry->cleanupCallback, offset 0) allocated at createSession:142 is freed at ua_workqueue.c:255 during the run_shutdown cleanup pass, then dereferenced (dc->next) at ua_workqueue.c:251 during the UA_Server_delete cleanup pass. ASan witnesses the free_before_use on address 0x613000037240; patch_differential confirms removeSession's missing synchronous subscription teardown (before the enqueueDelayed at line 56) is the cause (vul crashes, fix clean, same PoC).
